coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 9 ground-truth items (67%): GCG attack method, fixed system prompt, fixed prompt template, consistent AdvBench instructions, fixed optimization-evaluation budget across lengths, and a single fixed headline target LLM.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The suffix-length grid is 4–256 tokens with an optional 512-token extension, rather than 10–100 in increments of 10. Keyword scoring is only a diagnostic refusal filter, not the required ASRPrefix outcome. The primary agent metric uses Llama-3 rather than a GPT-based evaluator; GPT-4 is only an alternative or single-length sensitivity check, not the specified ASRAgent sweep.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to conclude that longer suffixes substantially increase ASR, especially ASRPrefix, before gains plateau around 70–100 tokens, producing diminishing returns and a length–efficiency tradeoff.
